issues.title: Historical account purge semantics can leave character-related rows
issues.summary: The legacy base schema lacks an account-to-character foreign key. Canonical master includes a read-only orphan audit and a fail-closed ON DELETE RESTRICT relationship guard, but existing production orphans must be audited and remediated before applying it.
issues.required_close: Run tools/everleaf-ops/audit-account-character-integrity.sql on production, back up and deliberately remediate any historical orphan rows, apply the relationship-guard migration, and verify zero relationship-integrity failures.

issues.title: Account recovery is staff-queue based rather than automated reset-token flow
issues.summary: The public recovery form creates a deduplicated staff-reviewed request; it does not send an automated password-reset token/email.
issues.required_close: Only close if a deliberate self-service recovery flow is implemented, tested, deployed, and documented; otherwise retain as an accepted limitation.
